notes: Atrium v0.9.1 — Inventory & Slim Sidebar: the Worktrees view now shows only what's running (Root always pinned + occupied worktrees only), with a clean two-row header — directory on row 1, branch on row 2. The new Inventory Dock tab is the full catalog of every worktree, occupied or idle, with live search, sort (name / panes / prunable-first), filter (all / idle / prunable), prunable/locked badges, and a per-row launch button. Launching into a worktree is now consolidated in one place.
